title: Nevers to Pisany and to Revol, August-October 1593, BnF fr. 3985 and fr. 3986 (catalogue item 21)

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 3985 no. 116, f. 209 (Gallica btv1b90606498 canvas 419)

transcription.notes: NOTES give 122 tokens; the measured 123 includes the clear word [de]. Copy, not original.

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 3986 no. 81, f. 168 (Gallica btv1b9060631k canvas 332)

transcription.notes: NOTES give 269 tokens; measured 272. 1/7, 0/8, 3/5 confusions in the copyist's hand leave stretches garbled.

transcription.source: Gallica IIIF full resolution, deskewed line cuts
transcription.notes: Raw measure 257 tokens but it includes crop separators and [clear markers, and some runs are faded clear cursive.
Raw measure 258 tokens including separators; re-read at 3.2x shows much of it is faded clear, so the cipher is over-read.

system.summary: Pisany letters: Nevers cipher no. 46, a two-digit alphabet with homophones, nulls, barred, plain and double-dotted figure series for words and names; Revol letters: the Court symbol cipher no. 60.

diacritics.note: Bar over a figure selects the word series, two dots the names series.

system.sibling_key: Nevers no. 45 (single-digit null convention) and Gondi to Pisany 22 Sept 1593 with office decipherment (conventions check); key no. 60 checked on interlined Henri IV letters and the 31 Aug Instruction.
system.notes: Two keys in one catalogue item; system fields describe no. 46. No. 60 is a symbol alphabet with about five homophones per letter and a syllabary.

prior_solution.where: Tomokiyo (cryptiana) read passage 1 of f. 209 and line 1 of f. 168

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Gallica full-resolution canvases of fr. 3985, 3986, 3995 fetched; items mapped to folios.
Key no. 46 transcribed from fr. 3995 f. 87 at full resolution.
Alphabet checked on Gondi's 22 Sept letter with the office decipherment.
8 Sept letter to Pisany read whole.
14 Oct letter to Pisany read in long stretches; garbled stretches left.
Revol letters found to be in the Court key no. 60, not no. 46; the 27 Aug copy is in clear.
Key no. 60 transcribed in full from fr. 3995 ff. 109-111 and checked on the interlined King's letter of 7 Oct.
f. 146v and f. 157v transcribed and decoded; anchors only, copyist's cursive forms block the rest.
Instruction of 31 Aug found in print (Memoires de Nevers ii) and interlined in fr. 3985; glyph atlas begun.

outcome.method_basis: The Pisany letters were read with Tomokiyo's Nevers cipher no. 46, transcribed here at full resolution from BnF fr. 3995 f. 87 and checked on Gondi's 22 Sept 1593 letter with its office decipherment; the Revol letters are in Court key no. 60 and are not read.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Not measurable as a token share: the Pisany letters are counted (decode_f209.txt 122/122, decode_f168.txt 268/269 figures resolve in key no. 46), but the Revol transcriptions ct_3986_f146v.txt and ct_3986_f157v.txt mix clear cursive with cipher and are not yet segmented, and four Revol passages (ff. 88, 115, 176, 198) are untranscribed, so the denominator is unknown; 0.3 is by letters (2 of 7).
outcome.notes: Two of seven letters read (Pisany); five Revol letters in key no. 60 unread, blocker palaeographic. fraction_read 0.3 is an estimate by letters (2 of 7 read, the second in stretches); no token count exists for the Revol passages.
